Step:  
02-06-1283 is June 2, 1283.  
Subtract 41 days:  
June has 30 days, so back to May:  
June 2 → May 23 (10 days back: June 2 → May 23).  
Remaining 31 days to subtract: 41 - 10 = 31.  
May 23 → April 22 (subtract 23 days to reach May 1, then 8 more days into April: April 30 → April 22).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1283-04-22
